# Cncf Urunc Reviewer

Review urunc using its official documentation and repository in the Runtime / Container Runtime category. A CRI-compatible runtime for running unikernels and application kernels as containers.  urunc bridges the gap between unikernels and containerized environments, enabling seamless  integration with cloud-native architectures while maintaining OCI compatibility.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
